description: This Java source file defines the ICalHandlerFactory class, which implements a WebDAV request handler factory for iCalendar. It maps HTTP methods to specific handler functions, primarily delegating to the ICalWorker class for GET, PUT, and PROPFIND requests, and handles other methods with no action or invalid method responses.

classes.name: ICalHandlerFactory
classes.description: A factory class that provides WebDAV request handlers for iCalendar operations, mapping HTTP methods to specific handler functions.

methods.name: getHandler
methods.description: Returns the appropriate RequestHandler based on the HTTP method; defaults to invalid method handler if method is unrecognized.

methods.name: handleInvalidMethod
methods.description: Handles unsupported HTTP methods by logging and sending a 405 Method Not Allowed error.

methods.name: doNothing
methods.description: Handles HTTP methods that require no action by logging and setting response status to OK.

methods.name: doGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests by delegating to ICalWorker.handleGetRequest.

methods.name: doPut
methods.description: Handles PUT requests by delegating to ICalWorker.handlePutRequest.

methods.name: doPropFind
methods.description: Handles PROPFIND requests by delegating to ICalWorker.handlePropFindRequest.
